description: Call this tool to draw a linear barcode (code128, ean13, ean8, upca) as SVG, or PNG to out_path. A short EAN or UPC gets its check digit computed; a wrong one is refused, never redrawn. qr_create makes QR codes.

height.description: Bar height in the same units (default 80)

module_width.description: Width of the narrowest bar, in pixels or SVG units (default 2)

out_path.description: Name for the downloaded file, e.g. acme-code. SVG is returned inline when this is left out; a PNG always comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace a file of the same name already produced in this request (default false)

symbology.description: code128 for any printable ASCII, ean13 and ean8 for retail products, upca for North American retail

text.description: Print the digits under the bars (default true)

value.description: The data to encode. Digits only for EAN and UPC

name: barcode_create
title: Barcode
